newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol plans 1.6 trillion pta investment.
newsitem.headline: Repsol plans 1.6 trillion pta investment.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol SA plans to make 1.6 trillion pesetas in investments over the next five years, Repsol chairman Alfonso Cortina said on Thursday.
Cortina, who was addressing an Spanish Energy Club luncheon, said most of the investment would be made in Latin America, exploration and production and natural gas.
"Apart from exploration and production, Latin American investment over the next five years will reach 350 billion pesetas," he said.
Repsol will spend 200 billion on natural gas projects under a joint plan of investments with Gas Natural.
